title: The hero button's focus ring is clipped
body:
## Problem

Tab to `index.html`'s hero button and its purple focus ring is cut off. The button sits in `.toolbar`, which has `overflow: hidden`, and `style.css` draws the ring 2px *outside* the button (`.hero-button:focus-visible { outline-offset: 2px; }`), so the toolbar clips it flat on every side.

The ring only shows on keyboard focus. Nothing on the page changes until you Tab to the button.

## What to do

In `style.css`, change `.hero-button:focus-visible`'s `outline-offset` from `2px` to `-5px`, so the ring draws inside the button where the toolbar can't clip it. Nothing else changes.

## Done when

- `style.css`'s `.hero-button:focus-visible` rule reads `outline-offset: -5px;`.
- `npm run dev` (`python3 -u serve.py`, per `package.json`) still serves `index.html` with no errors.
